hich has apparently been there since the break up 30 days ago (honestly gross).

and we are told that this won't be the end of it.

notices her messy hair unibrow and unflattering middle school My Little Pony t-shirt.

Red dress it is.
Out to the car and to go shopping.
First stop a salon.

and the decision is made for a manicure (one of the least permanent options - phew).
A choice of nail colours is to be made between Envy Green and Green Grass.
Green Grass is the selection.

Then shopping.
Which shop?
"Adam's shop" or the one with the terrible display.
Adam's shop it is.
This is apparently Abercrombie.
They go in
and see Adam
and decide not to leave because why the hell should they
and she can't avoid going to the places he goes to forever.
Now the narrative really jumped for me here because we're suddenly in a coffee shop
and I have no idea how we got here
because it didn't say and was quite jarring.
Lex is talking to someone she know
and Emily goes to order the drinks.
The barista is a cute guy.
Emily orders 2 daily specials.
The barista says she doesn't look like a daily special person.
She says what do they look like?
The barista is muscley and tattooed.
She realises her money is in the bottom of her bag
but she can't get it out because of the manicured nails.
She's having a bad day
and tells the barista
asks if he can fish the card out of the purse.
He does.
When he hand the card back she accidentally scratches his hand with her nails
and is mortified.
He says he will bring the drinks over to her table.
She goes to sit
and someone she recognises from class asks if she'll take a photo.
She tries to refuse
but he shoves the phone in her hand
and asks her to record actually and not just take a photo.
So she does.
He gets on one knee
and proposes to his girlfriend who says yes.
There is a pug at the door who you don't let in
but then some other guy does
and the pug is carrying a ring for them.
She stops filming
and hand the phone back
and mopes some more.
Her monthiversary is going to be their engagement anniversary.
Mope
Mope.
She sits at the table.
Lex comes in
comments on the cute barista
and says she has to go home and email a presentation in in the next 30 mins or her group will lose 10% of their mark.
She suggests meeting at her place in 1 hour.
She leaves.
The barista brings over the drinks.
One has a smiley face in the foam.
They chat a little.
He talks about soccer (football)
and says they are only in D3 (I have no idea what that means)
but she should come watch sometime.
She drinks her drink.
The cinnamon warms her throat.
Prior to this she has somehow sat on blue chalk dust
and a bird has pooped on her.
I think before going to Abercrombie. Lex's idea of a good time is makeup and a dress and a frat party.
She goes to Lex's at the right time.
Lex does her make up.
Gives her cheekbones
and she does a fish lips face.
They go to the party at the sorority house.
Lex's friend approaches Emily.
She has been drinking with beer on her breath.
She greets Emily as Adam's girlfriend.
Emily says ex.
The girl says she knows a secret.
She tells Emily that Lex never thought Emily and Adam were good together.
Emily is annoyed for some reason.
It's slightly inexplicable but she confronts Lex who admits to it readily
and then Emily seems to stop caring immediately.
Lex points out the barista.
We learn that his is called Ryan
and apparently like all Ryans (Reynolds Gosling Seacrest) he is handsome.
His curly hair is also mentioned several times.
She starts to approach him on the balcony
and then swerves at the last minute as she changes her mind.
He speaks to her anyway.
They talk for hours (3?) about a lot of stuff.
He's scared of needles.
Something about his little sister?
A natural lull occurs
they start speaking again at the same time.
He lets her speak first.
How considerate!
(It really isn't but heyho).
She reflects on how Adam wouldn't have bothered to do this especially after the start of their relationship
he seemed not to care about her enough to show much consideration anymore.
She asks Ryan to dance.
They do.
It's crowded so there isn't much else possible but his hands on her waist and hers hugging his shoulders/neck.
She rests her head on his chest at some point.
The party ends.
She likes Ryan
but it's a bit soon.
She asks him to get her purple pen from her bag.
He does in a call back to the purse incident earlier.
She writes a date on his hand one month from that day
and says call me then and I might be ready because of the breakup being more in the past.
Both seriously underestimating how long it takes to get over a long term relationship and Ryan's ability to physically know her number.
She goes home.
A small amount of moping and reflection.
She makes some trite observations about relationships.
She sees the piano
and plays it for the first time since the break up.
There is dust on the keys.
She and Adam used to play all the time.
She sees a box of ticket stubs and mementos from her and Adam's relationship.
She finds it strange that the time is now encapsulated in paper and (apparently) polystyrene (a cup??? what is this?).
She throws it away.
No more Pringles for her.
